name: Pad
description: Pad is local-first project management for developers and AI coding agents. Single Go binary, SQLite by default, MCP-ready (Claude Code / Cursor / Windsurf). Your data stays on your Unraid box — no telemetry, no account required, no cloud lock-in. After install, click the container's Logs button to grab the first-run bootstrap token, then visit the WebUI to claim the first admin. See the install guide for screenshots: https://getpad.dev/docs/self-hosting/Unraid

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Pad's persistent data: SQLite database, attachments, encryption key, logs, and config. Back this up to keep your workspace safe.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Pad web UI. Browse to http://[your-tower]:[port]/ after install.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID the pad process runs as. Default 99 (nobody) matches Unraid's appdata permissions. Change only if you know what you're doing — must be a positive integer.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID the pad process runs as. Default 100 (users) matches Unraid's appdata permissions. Change only if you know what you're doing — must be a positive integer.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Verbosity for the server log. One of: debug, info, warn, error.

variables.name: Bypass Setup Token
variables.description: If true, the first admin account can be created directly from the web UI (browse to http://[your-tower]:[port]/setup) without copying a bootstrap token from the container logs. Convenient for trusted home networks. Default false (token required from logs). WARNING: while no users exist, anyone who can reach the WebUI port can claim the first admin account — only set true on networks you trust (LAN behind a firewall, Tailscale, etc.). Once an admin exists this setting has no effect.

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: External URL when pad is behind a reverse proxy (SWAG / NGINX Proxy Manager / etc.). Required for emailed invitation links to point at the right host. Example: https://pad.example.com

variables.name: Maileroo API Key
variables.description: Optional. Enables transactional email (workspace invitations). Without it, invites use copyable join codes via the CLI. Sign up at maileroo.com.

variables.name: Email From
variables.description: Sender address for invitation emails. Required if Maileroo API Key is set. Must be on a domain you control.

variables.name: Email From Name
variables.description: Display name on outbound emails (the human-friendly part before the address). Defaults to 'Pad'.
